title: A comment sent to Tracy is resolved as Tracy when a write cites its latest send; a reply reopens it; Ask Tracy to edit all leaves a sent, unchanged comment unticked with Sent hh:mm; the chat report lists it
steps: S0: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md). Site S = the WordPress test site (scv2wp.<stand domain>), P = its page origin as its comments carry it (e.g. http://scv2wp.scv2.tracy.test:34080). Pick a published post id PID and its exact title T from the site's database (read only).
S1: api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments '{"text":"[REG-043] probe","url":"$P/","element":null}' → keep comment.id as C.

S2: api a POST /api/sites/$S/requests '{"sessionId":"reg023-<ms>","requestId":"r-<ms>","items":[{"url":"$P/","element":null,"text":"","commentId":"C"}]}' → keep requests[0].n as N. Then api a GET /api/sites/$S/comments/sent.

S3: api a POST /api/sites/$S/apply '{"action":"content.update","params":{"kind":"post","id":PID,"fields":{"post_title":"T"},"apply_id":"reg023-<ms>"},"comment":N}' (the title written back unchanged). Then api a GET /api/sites/$S/comments and read the row with id C.
S4: api b POST /api/sites/$S/comments '{"text":"[REG-043] reply","url":"$P/","element":null,"replyTo":"C"}'. Read `parent`. Then api a GET /api/sites/$S/comments/sent.

S5: api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments '{"text":"[REG-043] Append the text \" [REG-043]\" to the title of the post \"T\".","url":"$P/","element":null}' → keep its id as U. Browser as seat a: open $O/$S, wait for /s/session-; click [data-conversation-tabs] [data-view='tracy-comments']; click 'All pages'; click .tv-cv-send-all; in [data-tracy-checklist] read each .tv-cv-checklist-row: its input's checked and its [data-sent-at] text.

S6: Untick every row except U's ([REG-043] Append…) if any is ticked, click [data-tracy-checklist] .tv-cv-primary. Poll site_turn of that session until its newest row is not open (≤ 10 min). Read that row's turn_id and comment_ns; api a GET /api/sites/$S/comments/report?turn=<turn_id>; read [data-tracy-comment-report] under the turn in the chat; api a GET /api/sites/$S/comments and read row U.
S7: Clean up: api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments/clear '{"ids":["C","U"]}'; write post PID's title back to T through the Apply door (or undo the turn's write from Site changes).
expect: S2: the sent list holds C with `at` = the send's time.
S3: Apply answers ok:true; row C has status 'resolved', resolvedByTracy true, resolvedBy {accountId:'', email:'', name:'Tracy', initial:'T', tracy:true}, and its last send's answeredAt set.
S4: parent.status 'pending' and parent.resolvedByTracy false; the sent list no longer holds C (new words after the send).
S5: a row of a comment already sent with nothing new since is unticked and shows 'Sent HH:MM' (24-hour); U's row (never sent) is ticked and has no [data-sent-at].

S6 (when Tracy's write cites U's request number): the report door lists U with done true; the chat shows [data-tracy-comment-report] reading 'Done: 1 comment (reply to a comment if you want more changes)' with a line data-report-comment=U; row U is resolved with resolvedByTracy true. When no write cited it: the report lists U with done false and the chat reads "Couldn't confirm: 1 comment" — never 'not done' — and U stays open.
evidence: 03/10: comments sent with Send all stayed open after Tracy did them; the next Send all ticked and re-sent them and Tracy redid the work (ADR 0025).
fence: Only the Apply door's answered_at stamp of a comment's latest send resolves it, and only with no reply or edit after that send; the Send all defaults come from the server's sent list
